name: open_book_pull
prerequisites: Ensure book is not attached or fixed to the surface
Verify gripper is calibrated and functional
constraints: Avoid excessive force that may damage the book
Ensure the book's position allows for complete opening without obstruction

explanations: move_gripper_to_pose('xvh', true, false) - Position gripper above point xvh for a top-down grasp, suitable for grabbing the edge of the book
close_gripper() - Grips the book securely for pulling
pull('jev', 'parallel', false, false, '') - Pulls the front cover of the book parallel to its surface to open it, using surface jev which is oriented appropriately for this action
open_gripper() - Releases the book after opening
retract_gripper() - Moves the gripper away to a safe position after the task is complete
